title: How a job rejection at Monkey Inferno led to Product Hunt LIVE VIDEO
summary: Ryan tells how he was turned down for an Entrepreneur-in-Residence role by Shaan Puri, stayed in touch, and two years later partnered with Shaan's team (Blab) to launch live video on Product Hunt LIVE. The lesson is about relationships, transparency and reframing "no".

principles.text: Never burn bridges: staying in touch after a rejection can seed future partnerships.
principles.quote: This is a great example of how important it is to never burn a bridge in Silicon Valley (or anywhere, really). Product Hunt LIVE VIDEO is happening because we stayed in touch and genuinely liked each other.
